design_philosophy.name: Sky High Productivity
design_philosophy.description: A professional, minimalist aesthetic that blends the trust of fintech with the engagement of gamification. It uses a sophisticated 'Glacial Blue' palette grounded by Swiss-style typography and layout, avoiding the cluttered 'casino' look of typical earning apps.

usage_rules.headings: Use 'Outfit' for all headings (h1-h6). Weight: 600 or 700. Letter-spacing: -0.02em.
usage_rules.body: Use 'Inter' for all paragraphs and UI text. Weight: 400 (regular) or 500 (medium).
usage_rules.numbers: Use 'Outfit' for large earning numbers/stats to make them pop.

primary.name: Electric Sky
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key branding elements.

secondary.name: Volt Gold
secondary.usage: Call to actions related to 'Earning', 'Coins', or 'Rewards'.

background.name: Glacial White
background.usage: Main app background. Never use pure white #FFFFFF for the body background.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0

cards.base: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.interactive: cursor-pointer hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/5 transition-all duration-300 group
cards.glass: bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-lg

inputs.base: h-12 bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all

navigation.mobile_bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-border h-16 flex items-center justify-around z-50
navigation.desktop_sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full w-64 bg-card border-r border-border p-6 flex flex-col

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Rounded line caps.

hero_student.alt: Happy student earning money on phone

abstract_bg.usage: Background for wallet or premium features

sky_clouds.usage: Subtle header background or splash screen

rules: Ensure text contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
Interactive elements must have a minimum touch target of 44x44px.
Focus states must be clearly visible (ring-2 ring-primary).
Use semantic HTML (main, nav, article, section).

setup: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to extend the theme with the new colors and fonts.
Update 'index.css' with the CSS variables provided in the 'colors' section.
Import the Google Fonts in 'index.css' or 'index.html'.

implementation_strategy.general: Start by setting up the global theme. Then build the layout shell (Sidebar/BottomNav). Then implement pages one by one.
implementation_strategy.dashboard: Use the 'Bento' grid layout. Create a 'StatCard' component for earnings.
implementation_strategy.tasks: Create a 'TaskCard' component. Use the 'Volt Gold' color for the reward amount to make it stand out.
implementation_strategy.ads: Implement the timer with a visual progress circle.
implementation_strategy.wallet: Make this feel secure. Use the 'ShieldCheck' icon and clean tables for transaction history.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use the specific 'primary' and 'gold' gradients defined.
